name: Vetcove
desc:
Vet Clinic Support Associate - Vetcove | $50,000 - $80,000/year (estimate: roughly $24 to $38/hr)
Company and Position Title: Vetcove, Vet Clinic Support Associate
Industry: Veterinary Technology, Customer Support / SaaS
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be the go-to person for thousands of veterinary professionals using Vetcove's ordering platform. Most of your day is spent answering questions through live chat, email, and phone, troubleshooting issues, and walking users through solutions in a way that's easy to understand. You'd also handle behind the scenes admin work like account management, item reviews, and credit approvals, and you'd work with other teams to flag feature requests and product issues. It's a fast paced support role at a growing tech company, not a call center script job, so there's real problem solving involved.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements:
 Education: 2 year Associate's degree or 4 year college degree required
 Required Experience: 1 year of relevant, customer facing work experience
 Preferred Experience: Experience with Intercom or similar chat support platforms, tech or startup work experience
 Required Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, patience and compassion in difficult situations, ability to manage multiple concurrent responsibilities, adaptability, and strong collaboration skills
Best Fit:
This role is ideal for
Someone with a college degree (associate's or higher) and at least a year of customer service experience
Someone who enjoys problem solving and troubleshooting, not just following a script
Someone comfortable in a fast paced, tech company environment
Someone who wants equity and growth potential alongside a support role
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone without a completed associate's or bachelor's degree, this is a hard requirement in the posting
Anyone without at least 1 year of customer facing work experience
Anyone who needs a confirmed hourly rate and set schedule, since pay is listed as an annual range and shift hours are not specified
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer support
Live chat support
Troubleshooting
Intercom
Account management
Cross functional collaboration
SaaS platform support
Written and verbal communication
Veterinary or animal health industry
Process improvement
notes:
Expected Application and Interviewing Process:
 You'll apply directly through Vetcove's careers page. Since this is a tech company support role, expect the interview process to include questions about how you handle difficult customer interactions and troubleshoot problems in real time. A background check is required once you receive an offer.
Sample interview questions to prepare for:
Tell us about a time you had to explain a technical issue to someone who wasn't tech savvy. How did you break it down?
Walk us through how you'd handle a frustrated customer who is having a recurring issue with the platform.
How do you prioritize your day when you have live chats, emails, and admin tasks all competing for your attention?
What interests you about working in the veterinary or animal health industry specifically?
Coach Notes:
 This is a stronger fit for a participant with some college education and prior customer service experience than a true entry level candidate, given the degree requirement is explicitly stated. Pay is attractive and benefits are strong, including equity, which is unusual for this pay tier. Flag the degree requirement clearly upfront so participants without one aren't set up for a rejection. Since shift hours are not specified, confirm during the application or recruiter screen.
other:
Pay, Background, DS, and Benefits:
 Pay: $50,000 to $80,000 per year, which works out to roughly $24 to $38 per hour depending on hours worked (this is an estimate based on a standard 2,080 hour work year, not a confirmed hourly rate, since the posting lists salary only). 
 Shift: Not specified in the posting
 Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, automatic 401k contribution, employee referral program, home office setup provided, open vacation policy, equity, and bi-annual company retreats
Equipment Provided:
 Yes. The posting specifically lists "at home office set up" as a benefit, so equipment is covered.
Felony Friendly and Drug Test:
 Not advertised as felony friendly. A background check is required for employment. No drug test mentioned in the posting.
Career Pathway: Vet Clinic Support Associate → Senior Support Associate → Customer Success Manager
